classification.difficultyReason: Translate grid displacements into tangent ratios and recognise that the marked angle is the difference between two inclinations to a common horizontal.

content.prompt: Find the angle $\theta$ marked in each of the square grids below. Give your answers to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Three-by-three square grid with a triangle and an angle between its two rays from the bottom-left corner. The blank-grid template cannot express the triangle and angle mark.
spec.mathematics: Vertices (0,0), (2,3), (3,2); theta is the angle between vectors (2,3) and (3,2).
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied grid, triangle and theta mark are visible.

answer.worked:
Measure each ray's angle from the horizontal using the square cells.
$$\begin{align*}\alpha&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)\\\beta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)-\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)\\\theta&\approx22.62^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Three-by-three square grid with a triangle and an angle between its two rays from the bottom-left corner. The blank-grid template cannot express the triangle and angle mark.
spec.mathematics: Vertices (0,0), (2,3), (3,1); theta is the angle between vectors (2,3) and (3,1).
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied grid, triangle and theta mark are visible.

answer.worked:
Measure each ray's angle from the horizontal using the square cells.
$$\begin{align*}\alpha&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)\\\beta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)-\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)\\\theta&\approx37.88^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Four-column, three-row square grid with a triangle and an angle between its two rays from the bottom-left corner. The blank-grid template cannot express the triangle and angle mark.
spec.mathematics: Vertices (0,0), (2,3), (4,1); theta is the angle between vectors (2,3) and (4,1).
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied grid, triangle and theta mark are visible.

answer.worked:
Measure each ray's angle from the horizontal using the square cells.
$$\begin{align*}\alpha&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)\\\beta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)-\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)\\\theta&\approx42.27^\circ\end{align*}$$
